summary: This clinical trial is testing the drug pemafibrate in adults with hypercholesterolemia, a condition meaning high levels of cholesterol in the blood. The study aims to help patients who have not had enough improvement from standard statin medications. Researchers will compare two different doses of pemafibrate against a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real treatment. A total of 120 participants are planned to take part in this research.
